summary.name: The Condution Project
summary.one_liner: Condution is an open-source task and project manager for creating and sharing tasks, projects, and filter perspectives.
use_cases: managing large projects with ordered tasks
sorting tasks by context and importance
summary.what_it_does: The page describes a task and project manager that supports due and start dates down to the second. Large projects can have sequentially ordered tasks. Tasks can be sorted by contexts and importance, and the project says it supports filter perspectives for viewing tasks. It also mentions planning and balancing daily to-dos and coordinating work between departments. Downloads are listed for macOS (darwin), Windows (win64) and Linux (AppImage) for version 1.2.1, with SHA-256 checksums shown.
notable: Open source, described as free forever
Due and start dates precise to the second
Sequentially ordered tasks for large projects
Downloads include SHA-256 checksums for version 1.2.1
caveats: Page says 'Available (Almost) Everywhere', so some platforms may be unsupported; only macOS, Windows and Linux AppImage builds are listed
Page does not describe detailed features, pricing tiers or sync options
